title: Longplay: The Incredible Machine (1993) [MS-DOS]
summary: A two-hour complete longplay of the 1993 MS-DOS puzzle game The Incredible Machine, in which players assemble Rube Goldberg contraptions to complete simple tasks.
why: Used as a nostalgic link to a beloved childhood game, and as an example of a tight failure-iteration learning loop.

quote.text: Absolutely adored this game as a child.
